knowledgeBases.name: PrinceAI Platform Architecture
knowledgeBases.description: Technical specs, security policies, and API endpoints

knowledgeChunks.text: PrinceAI Architecture consists of 18 cohesive phases starting from basic AI chat and conversation history to autonomous agents, multi-modal voice interaction, team RBAC, RAG knowledge indexing, and visual node workflow orchestration.

Security Model: PrinceAI strictly protects against Insecure Direct Object References (IDOR) by evaluating authorization and verified identity on all endpoints. Secret tokens and API keys are strictly retained on the backend and never exposed to the client.
